lines.text: Saul becomes king at thirty, keeps three thousand men, and Jonathan attacks the Philistine outpost at Geba.
The Philistines camp at Michmash with countless troops, and the men of Israel hide in caves and cisterns.
Saul waits seven days for Samuel at Gilgal, then offers the burnt offering himself just before Samuel arrives.
Samuel tells Saul he acted foolishly, so the LORD has sought a prophet just like Samuel to rule instead.

wrong_details.true: a man after His own heart

lines.text: Saul counts about two thousand men, and the Philistines forbid blacksmiths, so only Saul and Jonathan have swords or spears.
